name: context-harness
description: Context management for Claude Code: fold completed tool results into one-line pointers at compaction instead of summarizing, keep the project's intent and status files current, and, with a Jev key, judgment gates for announced-but-undone turns, secret files under other providers, and conditional instructions. Folding needs no key; every Jev setting is off by default.

keepRecentTurns.title: Turns kept verbatim
keepRecentTurns.description: Tool results from this many most recent turns are never folded.

minFoldChars.title: Smallest result to fold (characters)
minFoldChars.description: Smaller results stay; folding them saves little and costs a read_coordinate call when needed.

keepErrorsUnder.title: Keep errors shorter than (characters)
keepErrorsUnder.description: Short errors stay so the model does not repeat the same mistake.

keepTools.title: Tools never folded
keepTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results always stay.

foldAtPercent.title: Fold by itself at context % (0 = off)
foldAtPercent.description: After a turn, fold once the context window is at least this full.

minSavedPercent.title: Fold by itself only when it saves at least %
minSavedPercent.description: Each fold rebuilds the prompt cache once, so small gains are skipped.

intentFile.title: Intent file
intentFile.description: The agent's reading of what you want, with your own words as its source. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

phaseFile.title: Status board file
phaseFile.description: Where the work is, what is next, what needs you. Must be current before a fold. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

episodeDir.title: Episode log folder
episodeDir.description: Dated logs of what happened. Must have a new entry before a fold. Used only while it exists; empty turns it off.

stopGate.title: Stop gate (announced-but-not-done turns)
stopGate.description: off: nothing. shadow: Jev judges each turn end and only records it; the last paragraph (scrubbed) is sent to Jev. active: a judged announcement makes the model continue.

toolGate.title: Tool gate (secret files, non-Anthropic providers)
toolGate.description: off: nothing. shadow: records tool calls that touch secret files or print secrets. active: refuses them when the session is served by a provider other than Anthropic, and refuses writes to this plugin's own files. Nothing is sent to Jev.

toolJev.title: Tool gate: Jev judgment (external sessions)
toolJev.description: off: nothing. shadow: in sessions served by a provider other than Anthropic, Jev classifies each call the floor let through (open, standard, restricted, custom) from its path or command and records it; the scrubbed path or the command's first 200 characters are sent to Jev, never file contents. active: calls judged restricted or custom are refused.

stopThreshold.title: Stop gate threshold
stopThreshold.description: Jev's probability of 'announce' at or above which a turn counts as announcing work.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: A Jev call that takes longer is dropped and the gate does nothing.

stopCap.title: Stop gate calls per session
stopCap.description: Jev calls the stop gate may make in one session.

toolThreshold.title: Tool gate threshold
toolThreshold.description: Jev's probability of restricted plus custom at or above which a call counts as sensitive.

toolCap.title: Tool gate calls per session
toolCap.description: Jev calls the tool gate may make in one session; each target is asked once.

providerTrust.title: Provider trust
providerTrust.description: auto: decide from the session (first-party only with an Anthropic credential, no proxy, no custom CA, no Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, and an anthropic.com endpoint). external: always treat the session as served by another provider.

trustedProxies.title: Trusted local proxies
trustedProxies.description: Comma-separated host:port of local proxies known to forward to Anthropic only (for example 127.0.0.1:9100).

instructions.title: Conditional instructions
instructions.description: off: nothing. shadow: for each prompt you type, Jev judges which fragments' conditions hold and records it; the prompt (scrubbed, first 600 characters) and the fragments' conditions are sent to Jev, never their bodies. active: matching fragments are appended to that prompt once, and pinned fragments go at the end of the system prompt.

fragmentsDir.title: Fragments folder
fragmentsDir.description: Folder of *.md fragments with when:, keywords: and pin: frontmatter. ~ means your home folder.

instructionThreshold.title: Conditional instructions threshold
instructionThreshold.description: Jev's probability that a fragment's condition holds at or above which it is attached.

instructionCap.title: Conditional instructions calls per session
instructionCap.description: Jev calls the conditional instructions may make in one session.

foldJev.title: Fold relevance (shadow only)
foldJev.description: off: nothing. shadow: at each compaction, Jev judges which large earlier tool results the current request still needs, beside what the fold policy itself folded, and records it; your last prompt (scrubbed) and each result's tool and target are sent, never the contents.

foldCap.title: Fold relevance calls per session
foldCap.description: Jev calls the fold judgment may make in one session (24 results per call).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Kept in secure storage. Without it, the plugin's .env (TYPESAFE_API_KEY=) or the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable is used.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Reaches the same Jev through OpenRouter (openrouter.ai). Kept in secure storage. Without it, the plugin's .env (OPENROUTER_API_KEY=) or the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable is used.

jevProvider.title: Jev provider
jevProvider.description: auto: a TypeSafe key if there is one, else an OpenRouter key. typesafe or openrouter: only that provider's key; without it nothing is sent.
